event.text: Go to the emergency department now. Sudden severe testicular pain with swelling and nausea can mean the testicle has twisted and lost its blood supply, which needs urgent scrotal exam, ultrasound and possible surgery within hours to save it. Do not eat or drink, and have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. If pain becomes overwhelming or you faint, call 911.
